plus `district_extra` (tags shown under the map, or NULL). -->

:::: {.g-col-7}
```{r}
div(class = "ia-stats-2col",
  ui_stat_grid(
    ui_stat_card("Bills Sponsored", total_sponsored,
                 sprintf("%d sole · %d co-sponsored", n_sole, n_co)),
    ui_stat_card("Party Alignment",
                 if (has_stats) sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * leg_stats$with_party_pct) else "—",
                 if (has_stats) sprintf("%d with party · %d against",
                                        leg_stats$votes_with_party, leg_stats$votes_against_party)
                 else "No floor votes recorded"),
    ui_stat_card("Participation",
                 if (has_stats) sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * leg_stats$participation_rate) else "—",
                 "Of eligible floor votes"),
    ui_stat_card("Floor Votes", n_floor_votes, "Cast this session")
  )
)
```

::: {.ia-card}
::: {.ia-card-title}
District `r legislator$district`
:::

```{r}
district_num <- parse_district_number(legislator$district)
chamber <- chamber_name(legislator$role)
party_color <- if (legislator$party == "D") "#3F5B93" else "#A8433A"

# Every district in the chamber, the legislator's own highlighted and drawn on
# top; the shapes come from the shared geometry file (maps.R)
map_districts <- district_geometry(chamber, ga_district_plan(ga)) |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  select(District) |>
  left_join(people |> filter(role == legislator$role), by = c("District" = "district_num")) |>
  mutate(
    own          = District == district_num,
    fill         = if_else(own, party_color, "#CCCCCC"),
    fill_opacity = if_else(own, 0.6, 0.2),
    stroke       = if_else(own, party_color, "#000000"),
    weight       = if_else(own, 3, 1),
    label        = case_when(
      own          ~ paste(legislator$name, "-", legislator$district),
      !is.na(name) ~ paste0(name, " (", party, "-", district, ")"),
      .default     = paste("District", District)
    ),
    front        = own
  ) |>
  select(District, fill, fill_opacity, stroke, weight, label, front)

bbox <- st_bbox(district_geometry(chamber, ga_district_plan(ga)) |> filter(District == district_num))

district_map(map_districts, chamber, ga, bounds = bbox, height = 340) |>
  addTiles()
```
